basic_info.description: This charming 2-bedroom, full-floor flat lives like a single-family home and offers a serene retreat in the heart of Hayes Valley. Nestled on a quiet side street, this home invites you to escape the bustle of city life and relax in its thoughtfully updated spaces. The open concept living room and formal dining room make for easy entertaining, while the adjacent kitchen features great counterspace and cabinets. Two generously sized bedrooms are filled with sunlight that both walk out onto a private deck. In addition, step down to your own large, private outdoor oasis, a tranquil backyard surrounded by Japanese Maple and Bamboo, perfect for enjoying the sunshine, this peaceful space offers the ideal spot for unwinding. In addition to the lush yard, the entire garage is at your exclusive disposal, providing two tandem parking spaces, an extra bathroom, ample storage, and a workshop. Potential to convert this garage area into living space while keeping one car parking. This rare find is located in a two-unit building eligible for fast-track condo conversion, buyer to verify. Don't miss this ideal home minutes to shops, restaurants, and cafes on Hayes.
